references.authority: Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority of India (IRDAI)
references.title: Guidelines on Standardization of Exclusions in Health Insurance Contracts
references.summary: Mandates standardized list of non-payable items across all health insurance products. Distinguishes non-payable administrative charges from payable clinical consumables.
references.relevance: Provides legal basis for Annexure A non-payable deductions (Clause SP-4.1).

references.authority: Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority of India (IRDAI)
references.title: Master Circular on Standardization of Health Insurance Products
references.summary: Expressly prohibits insurers from applying proportionate room-rent deductions to ICU/ICCU charges, fixed-fee surgical implants, diagnostic investigations, and medicines/pharmacy.
references.relevance: Primary statutory citation used in Appeal Drafter (Finisher B) to overturn illegal ₹9,750 pharmacy cut.

references.authority: Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority of India (IRDAI)
references.title: IRDAI (Health Insurance) Regulations, 2016
references.summary: Mandates insurers and TPAs to furnish itemized deduction summaries with specific policy clause citations within 2 hours of hospital discharge request.
references.relevance: Empowers policyholders to demand transparent line-item audit statements pre-discharge.

references.authority: Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority of India (IRDAI)
references.title: IRDAI Annual Report 2023-24
references.summary: Records 57 crore lives covered, ₹26,038 crore disallowed/repudiated claims, and 71.2% aggregate settlement ratio in FY24.
references.relevance: Authoritative primary source for Scene 2 problem statistics.

references.authority: Executive Council of Insurers / Insurance Ombudsman
references.title: Insurance Ombudsman Rules, 2017
references.summary: Provides free statutory arbitration for insurance claim shortfalls up to ₹30 lakh after rejection or 30 days of insurer inaction.
references.relevance: Defines the formal escalation pathway embedded in the Appeal Letter.
